The '''Bandit Camp mine''' (or the '''Hobgoblin Mine''') is a [[mining]] site found north-east of the [[Bandit Camp (Wilderness)|Bandit Camp]] in the [[Wilderness]] from levels 32 to 35 and east of the [[Wilderness God Wars Dungeon]]. The mine is occupied by a large number of aggressive [[hobgoblin]]s, from whom the mine gets its nickname.
